title: Support ticket lifecycle, SLA, test visibility, and dedupe integrity

phases.objective: Prevent cross-context and concurrent duplicate creation, expose customer-safe ticket reads, and persist integrity atomically.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One canonical ticket identity is serialized in the database, creation and integrity persistence commit atomically, and list responses expose only customer-safe fields ordered by ticket or lifecycle-event activity.
steps: Resolve one unambiguous active tenant membership.
Derive the v2 identity from tenant, user, ticket type, capability, resource, relationship, parent, test class, environment, and visibility.
Verify migration columns and the dedupe-claim table before mutation.
Acquire the unique tenant-plus-dedupe claim row under the create transaction.
Create or append and persist integrity through the same connection.
Use an integrity-ready or genuinely pre-migration-safe customer projection.
assertions: Parent, capability, test class, environment, and visibility alter dedupe identity.
Two concurrent requests serialize; exactly one creates and the other appends after the first commit.
Commit and rollback release transaction-held coordination.
Persistence failure rolls back the ticket mutation.
Ordinary title text cannot silently classify a production request as a test.
Multiple active memberships require explicit tenant context.
Tenant responses omit internal summaries, internal actor data, and source-tool fields.

phases.objective: Provide cursor-paged dry-run findings and typed-confirmation apply that recalculates SLA from the effective locked lifecycle state.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Dry-run returns bounded continuation evidence; apply locks each current ticket, applies lifecycle first, computes SLA from that state, writes one audited event, and commits atomically.
steps: Authenticate the administrator and backend key.
Read one stable keyset page of open ticket findings.
Return dry-run and next_cursor without mutation.
Require APPLY_SUPPORT_TICKET_INTEGRITY_RECONCILIATION for apply.
Lock and reread each current target.
Resolve lifecycle, compute effective-state SLA, update, and append audit evidence.
assertions: A ticket closed by lifecycle repair cannot be written as newly resolved with stale breached SLA.
A missing or changed target fails closed under row lock.
Pagination continues beyond the newest batch.
Migration SLA backfill updates only changed SLA values and preserves updated_at.

phases.objective: Keep reads and dry-run available before migration while preserving legacy evidence and lifecycle-event ordering.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Integrity list and reconciliation services against a pre-migration schema contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: List and dry-run avoid migration-only columns, trusted legacy test evidence remains effective, and lifecycle events participate in activity ordering.
steps: Return a schema preflight with migration columns absent.
Build the customer projection without migration-only references.
Derive milestones and latest activity from lifecycle events.
Classify legacy simulation metadata without treating migration defaults as explicit evidence.
assertions: Pre-migration list and dry-run avoid unknown-column errors.
Legacy admin simulation metadata remains internal.
Lifecycle-event activity can move a ticket ahead of an older ticket-row timestamp.

phases.objective: Apply migration 1042 in an authorized non-production database and verify columns, claim table, trigger, ledger, reconciliation, and audited ticket readback.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Governed migration dry-run and apply followed by cursor-paged integrity reconciliation
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The canary database reports migration ledger success, all required columns, the dedupe-claim table and milestone trigger, and corrected audited tickets without customer-field leakage.
steps: Verify the target database is an approved non-production environment.
Run checksum-bound migration dry-run and inspect statement, destructive-operation, and confirmation evidence.
Apply migration 1042 through the governed migration executor under a current capability envelope.
Read back migration ledger, schema readiness, dedupe claim table count, and trigger count in the same cycle.
Run every reconciliation dry-run cursor page, apply approved corrections, and verify exact audited ticket identities.

phases.objective: Promote the reviewed exact head, apply migration 1042 through the governed Production path, and verify customer-safe readback and serialized dedupe behavior.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Exact-SHA Production promotion, governed migration apply, and post-deploy tenant/admin verification
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Production reports the reviewed SHA, successful migration and schema evidence, serialized duplicate creation, lifecycle-aware SLA, test exclusion, latest-event ordering, and customer-safe tenant responses.
steps: Promote the exact reviewed main SHA through the governed Production synchronization process.
Verify Production runtime parity before database mutation.
Run checksum-bound migration dry-run and apply migration 1042 under an independently approved Production capability envelope.
Read back migration ledger, columns, claim table, trigger, and exact audited tickets.
Run cursor-paged dry-run and approved reconciliation apply.
Verify tenant list field safety, test exclusion, event activity ordering, SLA state, and concurrent dedupe behavior.
